quality.review_scope: Source-scoped direct PbSe inks, selenium-precursor preparation, conventional comparison route, PbS and ZnO adjuncts, device fabrication, and distinct characterization and cost-estimation contexts. All seven main and seventeen SI pages were read as text and images. Unreported conditions and physical batch joins remain unknown; source conflicts remain explicit. This is not a complete laboratory SOP or a full-paper narrative Reader.
missing_fields: Exact physical batch identity and unreported source conditions remain unknown.
The table is captioned for 1 g of ink while the narrative follows approximately 3 g CdSe and 2.5 g PbSe intermediates; conversion and final normalization details are not supplied.

context_links.label: Operational recipe remains at its own reported scale
